supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed logons for svc-render began at 13:31 UTC and continued at roughly one-minute intervals through 13:46 UTC; the failures report status 0xc000006a.
The failures identify FILE-NWD-01 as the workstation, use LogonType 3, and show the same source IP and process name across the observed 4625 events.
Domain-controller records also show failed validation attempts for svc-render from FILE-NWD-01, with status 0xc000006a on 4776 records and status 0x18 on 4771 records.

The timing, account, host, and approximately one-minute cadence align with the supplied context that svc-render runs every minute on FILE-NWD-01 and its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC; stale job credentials are the most likely explanation for these failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show failed authentication events only; they do not include service/job configuration, password-rotation execution, or evidence that the RenderQueue job was updated.
The 4625 records name lsass.exe as the process, which does not identify the initiating service or executable.
The supplied evidence covers only the stated time window and does not establish whether there were successful logons or related activity outside it.
claims_not_established: The logs do not prove that the RenderQueue job caused the failures or that the scheduled password rotation occurred as planned.
The logs do not establish whether svc-render authenticated successfully elsewhere or whether any account misuse occurred outside the supplied records.
The available records do not identify who performed the rotation or whether the job credential was subsequently updated.
